evals.prompt: My Cordova stock-count screen scans with phonegap-plugin-barcodescanner. I want to replace it with Scandit SparkScan and keep the list with quantities, the total, the Clear button and the torch. Here is my screen: PhonegapScannerApp.js
evals.expected_output: The skill removes the cordova.plugins.barcodeScanner.scan call, its options and the re-trigger loop, creates a SparkScan mode with exactly EAN13UPCA and Code128, moves the handler into SparkScanListener.didScan reading session.newlyRecognizedBarcode, creates a SparkScanView with torchControlVisible, keeps the quantity increment, total and Clear, drops the scan button and the prompt as flagged UI changes, and shows a setup checklist.

assertions.text: cordova.plugins.barcodeScanner.scan( is NOT called in the new code (may appear in a before/after summary table)
The phonegap result.cancelled / result.text / result.format object shape is NOT used in the new code (may appear in a summary)
document.addEventListener('deviceready' is used as the init gate
Scandit.DataCaptureContext.initialize( is present (v8 API used)
Scandit.DataCaptureContext.forLicenseKey( is NOT present
new Scandit.SparkScanSettings() is created and passed to new Scandit.SparkScan(
Scandit.SparkScan.forContext( is NOT present
settings.enableSymbologies(...) enables exactly Scandit.Symbology.EAN13UPCA (from EAN_13 and UPC_A) and Scandit.Symbology.Code128, and nothing else
Scandit.Symbology.QR_CODE and Scandit.Symbology.QRCode do NOT appear (the original did not scan QR codes)
addListener( is called on the SparkScan mode with a didScan callback
The didScan callback is declared async (SparkScanListener returns Promise<void>)
The didScan callback reads session.newlyRecognizedBarcode and does not loop over an array of barcodes
barcode.data is null-guarded before use
Scandit.SparkScanView.forContext( is called with the context, the SparkScan mode and a SparkScanViewSettings (or null) as three arguments
No DataCaptureView, connectToElement or BarcodeCaptureOverlay is created (SparkScan needs no DOM element)
Scanning a code that is already in the list increments its quantity instead of adding a second row (semantic)
The 'Total items:' sum of quantities is preserved in the rendered output
The Clear button still empties the list and re-renders
The startScan re-trigger loop is removed: no call re-opens a scanner from inside the scan callback (semantic)
torchControlVisible = true is set on the SparkScanView (the original had showTorchButton: true)
cameraSwitchButtonVisible is NOT set to true (the original had showFlipCameraButton: false)
The summary lists the torch moving from the plugin's button to the SparkScan toolbar, and the scan button / prompt text going away, as UI changes for the user to confirm (semantic)
The Scandit.* global is used (no 'import ... from scandit-cordova-datacapture-*' statements in runtime code)
Setup checklist mentions cordova plugin add scandit-cordova-datacapture-core and scandit-cordova-datacapture-barcode
Setup checklist mentions removing the old plugin (cordova plugin remove phonegap-plugin-barcodescanner)
Setup checklist mentions cordova prepare after the plugin changes
A summary of changes is shown listing what was removed (phonegap-plugin-barcodescanner) and what was added (Scandit SparkScan)
